lede: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh leads this digest with his first filing since taking office in May: 60 transactions from May 27 to June 23, 2026 — 59 sales estimated at $43.7 million and one purchase. Fifty-two of the rows are sales of numbered series of THSDFS LLC, alongside Bessemer Venture funds and stakes in the startups Aven and Hebbia; none were flagged late. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy disclosed a single sale of Rumble Inc stock, $1,001 to $15,000, dated February 3, 2025 — reported to OGE in June 2026 and flagged late by the filing's own certification. Social Security Commissioner Frank J. Bisignano reported two SPDR S&P 500 ETF purchases on June 16 totaling an estimated $825,000, and Office of Science and Technology Policy Director Michael J. Kratsios reported one purchase of a Vanguard tax-exempt bond ETF, $1,001 to $15,000.
